What prospects see in each offer version

The audit app runs on your own computer, so here is everything it produces for one sample business, side by side. Version A is “first 30 days free”; version B is “we work free until you get results”.

Sample data: “Oak & Ash Tree Co” in Sunnyvale is made up (mock mode), so the numbers are invented.

1. First email 2. Audit PDF 3. Report email 4. Checkout page 5. Your settings

Step 1 · Same for both versions

The first email asks permission and never mentions price

It says who you are, then names a real spot near them they can check on their phone, and who Google shows there.

Subject: Oak & Ash Tree Co vs Sunnyvale Tree Care on Google Hi Maria, I'm Tom Vinkler, based in Santa Clara. I help a few local tree service companies get more Google reviews without adding work for their team. I was looking at tree service companies in Sunnyvale on Google and came across your listing. When someone about 1 mile north of you searches “tree removal”, Google’s top 3 are Sunnyvale Tree Care, Metro Arborists and Sunnyvale Tree Service. You’re #11 there, too far down for most people to see. You can check it on your phone next time you’re over that way. You've clearly got happy customers, but you have 135 reviews while Sunnyvale Tree Care in Sunnyvale has 675. When someone compares two listings, they usually pick the one that looks more established, even if the other does better work. I put together a one-page map of where you show up across Sunnyvale and where you don't. Would it be all right if I sent it over? No charge, it's yours either way. Tom Vinkler Promoflix Santa Clara, CA hello@promoflix.ai Not relevant? Just reply "no" and I won't follow up.

Version A
Subject: Oak & Ash Tree Co — your local Google visibility report Hi Maria, Here's the report I mentioned. Oak & Ash Tree Co captures 16% of local searches within 1 mile of your location. Sunnyvale Tree Care captures 72%. How you rank today: - Google verifies your address and ranks you #1 at your door, holding the top 3 within 0.5 miles. - At the edge of your 1-mile radius, your listing drops into the red zone outside the top 10, handing calls across town to Sunnyvale Tree Care. - Searchers comparing your 135 reviews to Sunnyvale Tree Care's 675 will naturally pick the larger profile as the safer decision. What moves the pins: - You gained no new reviews in the last 30 days; Sunnyvale Tree Care gained 7. Consistent monthly reviews signal fresh momentum to Google, helping you steadily overtake older, dormant listings. - Today 10% of your reviews get a reply. Posting owner replies to 100% of reviews that name your services (“tree removal”, “stump grinding”, “emergency storm work”) keeps your profile active and puts those terms in front of Google. - The Review Engine asks 100% of real customers for a review right after each completed job, with no filtering, so reviews keep coming without your team having to remember. Where you run the test

Settings · A/B test results
Audit screen · step 3
Settings · section 5
  • The results table counts, for each version, audits made, checkout pages opened and start buttons clicked. Paid sign-ups show in Stripe with references ending in _a or _b.
  • The step 3 picker lets you force one version for a single audit. Otherwise it follows Settings.
  • Section 5 holds each version’s wording and its own Stripe link. Version A’s link needs Stripe’s 30-day free trial switched on.
